latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Image to Video Journey — turn photos into shareable videos with ease.

- Instantly converts 5–10 photos into 1080p animated video clips, ready to download in under a minute.
- Supports easy drag-and-drop photo upload and natural language prompts for custom video creation.
- No timeline editing or manual export settings required; specify your needs in plain language.
- Automatic cloud rendering with support for transitions, background music, and social media-friendly formats.
- Built-in credit management, session handling, and status feedback for a seamless user experience.
- Comprehensive error handling for tokens, uploads, rate limits, and export access.
